breakdown.description: The prescribed global horizontal point load is projected onto the local normal direction of the skew boundary
breakdown.reason: The incomplete prompt incorrectly asked to project the global horizontal point load onto the local normal direction of a skew boundary. The ground truth corrected this by simply stating to apply the point load as specified. The generated specification correctly states: 'Apply a concentrated point load of -5000 N in the global x-direction at the point (1.1, 0.15)', completely omitting the incorrect instruction about projecting the load, thus aligning with the ground truth's fix.
